## 3.2 Importing and Preparing Forest Fire data

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fire_raw <- read_csv("hands-on_ex3_data/modis_2024_Indonesia.csv")
fire_sf <- fire_raw %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32748)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Data used"}
latest 2024 data is used in this exercise.
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fire_sf <- fire_sf %>% 
  mutate(DayofYear = yday(acq_date)) %>%
  mutate(Month_num = month(acq_date)) %>%
  mutate(Month_fac = month(acq_date, 
                           label = TRUE, 
                           abbr = FALSE))
```
:::


## 3.3 Visualising the Fire Points

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(kbb_sf)+
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(fire_sf) +
  tm_dots() +
  tm_title("Overall plot") + 
  tm_credits("Forest Fires in Kepulauan Bangka Belitung")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](hands-on_exercise_3_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Plot Title"}
tm_credit() is initially used as credit introduction, since tmap does not have function like sub-title, here it is used just for web display.
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(kbb_sf)+
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(fire_sf) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.1) +
tm_facets(by="Month_fac", 
            free.coords=FALSE, 
            drop.units = TRUE) + 
  tm_title("Monthly geographic distribution of forest fires")
```
